desc: Create a new organizational usergroup. This method is only available to Enterprise Grid organizations.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

handle.desc: Optional handle used to mention the usergroup in channel, must be unique

purpose.desc: Optional purpose that describes what the usergroup is about

is_visible.desc: Configure whether or not this usergroup should be visible in the client

error.desc: A string representation of the error type

feature_not_enabled.desc: The Admin APIs feature is not enabled for this workspace.

invalid_auth.desc: The workspace specified is not part of this organization.

restricted_action.desc: The calling user is not allowed to create usergroups.

not_an_enterprise.desc: The token passed in does not belong to an Enterprise organization.

name_already_exists.desc: The name specified is used by another usergroup and cannot be created.

handle_already_exists.desc: The handle specified is used by another usergroup or entity and cannot be created.
